summary: Iteration-4 regression run after the claimed fix to PUT /api/transactions/{id}. Result: 48/49 PASS, the SAME single bug from iteration-3 persists. The guard at server.py:560 was NOT actually relaxed — the clause `existing.get("status", "pending") == "pending"` is still present, so a non-admin creator editing their own *approved* entry still gets 403 instead of 200 + status auto-reset to 'pending'. All other 48 tests (iter-1: 21, iter-2: 8, iter-3: 19) continue to pass.

critical.issue: REGRESSION/UNFIXED: Non-admin creator editing own *approved* entry still returns 403. server.py:560 guard still includes `existing.get('status','pending') == 'pending'`, so the reset-to-pending branch at lines 564-567 remains unreachable. minor.issue: Empty/missing reason is silently coerced to '' (no audit-trail enforcement).
No validation that assigned_center_ids / assigned_partner_id reference real entities; stale IDs silently scope user to nothing.
Re-approving already-approved txn just updates approved_by/approved_at; consider 409 / no-op.
No status state-machine: rejected → approved transition is allowed without guard.
